title: Normalized beta construction and pullback
statement: Construction and normalization subpackage: under the hypotheses of lem-sfb-finite-free-scalar-derived-comparison-beta, there exists a natural beta comparison satisfying AugmentationNormalized at every scheme and the displayed pullback equation.

proof.text: Choose flat-term K-flat representatives, use the restricted K-flat tensor identification, and descend the augmentation-induced comparison. Transport it through exact point pullback to obtain naturality and the pullback equation.

mathlib_searches.results: Only the target declaration; no existing theorem supplies this strict subpackage.
